provenance.paper_title: VLA-Pro: Cross-Task Procedural Memory Transfer for Vision-Language-Action Models

representation_paths.memory_component: structured action, object, orientation, and interaction-point sequences

evidence.paraphrase: Each task adapter is indexed by a sequence of structured procedural states; action-aware field similarity retrieves the top-k relevant source tasks.
Offline task-specific LoRA adapters store executable experience; retrieved adapters are similarity-weighted, fused, and temporarily loaded for the current action chunk.

derived.hybrid_relation: Every structured procedural-state index points to a parameterized LoRA memory that is activated after retrieval.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): The full-paper lifecycle review found structured action, object, orientation, and interaction-point sequences fixed during downstream inference; query-conditioned access, preprocessing, or training-time changes were not counted as persistent deployed updates. No persistent inference-time T2 update or deployment-feedback policy evolution was found.
